sections.title: The Final Five O'Clock
sections.end_condition: Artie's physical body is destroyed in a freak server-room collapse.
sections.intent: Establish Artie's mundane life and the catastrophic accident that triggers the transition.

scenes.outcome: Artie is trapped in the server room as the earthquake begins.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie checks the diagnostic logs one last time before his shift ends.
scenes.transition_out_text: The floor begins to vibrate violently, throwing Artie against the wall.

scenes.outcome: Artie's physical body is destroyed in a freak server-room collapse.
scenes.transition_in_text: Ceiling tiles collapse as the building groans under the seismic pressure.
scenes.transition_out_text: Consciousness fades into a sea of flickering blue code.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie's physical body is destroyed in a freak server-room collapse.

sections.title: Buffer Overflow
sections.end_condition: Artie triggers a recursive logic loop in the stat allocation menu.
sections.intent: Depict the character creation suite glitching as Artie's consciousness attempts to load.

scenes.outcome: Artie realizes he is in a character creation menu with corrupted data.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie wakes up in a blinding white space filled with floating menus.
scenes.transition_out_text: He reaches out to touch a stat bar that is vibrating at an impossible frequency.

scenes.outcome: Artie successfully manipulates the junk data to boost his Luck stat.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie drags a corrupted data fragment over his Luck attribute.
scenes.transition_out_text: The entire UI begins to stutter as the logic fails to resolve the new value.

scenes.outcome: Artie triggers a recursive logic loop in the stat allocation menu.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie confirms the corrupted build, forcing the system to accept the 'NaN' value.
scenes.transition_out_text: The white void shatters like glass, dropping him into the game world.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie triggers a recursive logic loop in the stat allocation menu.

sections.title: The Spawn Point Error
sections.end_condition: Artie spawns into the tutorial zone with a stat sheet that shouldn't exist.
sections.intent: Artie finalizes his 'corrupted' build and enters the game world.

scenes.outcome: Artie's avatar begins to render with visible visual artifacts.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie hits the ground hard, his hands flickering between solid and wireframe.
scenes.transition_out_text: A system message appears, attempting to run a repair protocol.

scenes.outcome: The system repair fails, cementing Artie's glitched stats.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie bats away the repair notifications, laughing at the absurdity.
scenes.transition_out_text: He stands up and checks his character sheet one last time.

scenes.outcome: Artie spawns into the tutorial zone with a stat sheet that shouldn't exist.
scenes.transition_in_text: The world snaps into focus as the tutorial loading screen finally clears.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie takes his first step into the game world, ready to break it.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie spawns into the tutorial zone with a stat sheet that shouldn't exist.

sections.title: Quest Log Exploits
sections.end_condition: Artie identifies a repeatable quest that fails to check for completion flags.
sections.intent: Artie identifies the first major flaw in the tutorial's quest-completion logic.

scenes.outcome: Artie enters the tutorial village and receives his first quest.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie walks into the village, his high Luck stat already causing NPCs to stare.
scenes.transition_out_text: He approaches the village elder, who has a glowing yellow exclamation mark.

scenes.outcome: Artie realizes the quest 'Collect 5 Berries' can be completed without losing the berries.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie picks the berries, but notices they don't leave his inventory when he turns them in.
scenes.transition_out_text: The elder thanks him, but the quest doesn't disappear from his log.

scenes.outcome: Artie identifies a repeatable quest that fails to check for completion flags.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie turns the quest in again, and again, watching his XP bar tick up.
scenes.transition_out_text: He grins as he realizes the system is failing to mark the quest as 'Done'.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie identifies a repeatable quest that fails to check for completion flags.

sections.title: Compounding Interest
sections.end_condition: Artie achieves a x1000 reward multiplier on a hidden tutorial achievement.
sections.intent: Artie grinds the exploit to stack illegal reward multipliers.

scenes.outcome: Artie discovers that consecutive turn-ins trigger a 'Hidden Effort' multiplier.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie continues the cycle, his movements becoming a blur of efficiency.
scenes.transition_out_text: A new notification pops up: 'Hidden Achievement: Persistent Gatherer'.

scenes.outcome: The multiplier begins to stack exponentially due to his glitched Luck.
scenes.transition_in_text: The Luck stat intervenes, turning a linear bonus into an exponential one.
scenes.transition_out_text: The XP notifications are now screaming at him in a rapid-fire sequence.

scenes.outcome: Artie reaches the soft-cap for tutorial rewards but pushes past it.
scenes.transition_in_text: A warning message appears: 'Reward Cap Reached'. Artie ignores it.
scenes.transition_out_text: The multiplier continues to climb as the system's logic breaks down.

scenes.outcome: Artie achieves a x1000 reward multiplier on a hidden tutorial achievement.
scenes.transition_in_text: The final turn-in triggers a screen-shaking explosion of gold light.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie stands in the center of the square, bathed in the light of an illegal achievement.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie achieves a x1000 reward multiplier on a hidden tutorial achievement.

sections.title: The Golden Handshake
sections.end_condition: Artie exits the tutorial zone carrying a legendary-tier inventory item.
sections.intent: Artie collects the massive payout and prepares to leave the starting zone.

scenes.outcome: Artie receives the 'Tutorial Master's Ring', which has glitched stats.
scenes.transition_in_text: The system, confused by the x1000 multiplier, generates a reward from the wrong loot table.
scenes.transition_out_text: He picks up the ring, and the tool-tip is a mess of question marks.

scenes.outcome: Artie organizes his inventory, now overflowing with high-tier consumables.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie sorts through his bags, which are stuffed with more gold and potions than the tutorial should allow.
scenes.transition_out_text: He looks toward the exit gate, where the tutorial's protection ends.

scenes.outcome: Artie exits the tutorial zone carrying a legendary-tier inventory item.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie steps through the barrier, the legendary ring glinting on his finger.
scenes.transition_out_text: The tutorial is behind him, but the system is already starting to flag his presence.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie exits the tutorial zone carrying a legendary-tier inventory item.

sections.title: Stop Right There
sections.end_condition: Artie is cornered by the scripted Guard Captain for unauthorized entry.
sections.intent: The local authorities attempt to process Artie's anomalous presence.

scenes.outcome: Artie arrives at the gates of the capital city, Oakhaven.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie walks up to the gate, his level 1 tag floating above his head.
scenes.transition_out_text: The guards' eyes widen as they see his legendary ring.

scenes.outcome: Artie is flagged as an 'Unauthorized Entity' by the city's scanners.
scenes.transition_in_text: A magical scanner sweeps over Artie, and immediately starts screaming.
scenes.transition_out_text: The guards draw their swords, and a heavy footfall echoes from the city.

scenes.outcome: Artie is cornered by the scripted Guard Captain for unauthorized entry.
scenes.transition_in_text: Captain Kaelen steps forward, his level 50 tag a terrifying contrast to Artie's level 1.
scenes.transition_out_text: Kaelen points his spear at Artie's chest. 'You don't belong here, bug.'
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie is cornered by the scripted Guard Captain for unauthorized entry.

sections.title: Collision Detection
sections.end_condition: Artie creates a physics-based feedback loop using three stackable boxes.
sections.intent: Artie uses tutorial-tier items to break the local physics engine.

scenes.outcome: Artie spots three physics-enabled crates in the gatehouse corner.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie looks around desperately and sees three crates marked with the 'Physics' icon.
scenes.transition_out_text: He kicks the first crate toward the Captain's feet.

scenes.outcome: Artie stacks the crates in a way that clips their collision boxes.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie uses his glitched Luck to perfectly align the crates' edges until they overlap.
scenes.transition_out_text: The sound of a thousand jackhammers fills the room as the physics engine struggles.

scenes.outcome: Artie creates a physics-based feedback loop using three stackable boxes.
scenes.transition_in_text: The crates begin to spin at an impossible speed, generating a localized gravity well.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie steps back, watching the Captain get sucked toward the glitch.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie creates a physics-based feedback loop using three stackable boxes.

sections.title: The Sky-High Captain
sections.end_condition: The Guard Captain is launched into the stratosphere by a collision bug.
sections.intent: The confrontation concludes with a spectacular system failure.

scenes.outcome: The Captain attempts to strike the crates, triggering the final bug.
scenes.transition_in_text: Captain Kaelen roars and brings his spear down on the center of the vibrating mass.
scenes.transition_out_text: The spear doesn't break; it transfers all the crates' kinetic energy into the Captain.

scenes.outcome: The Captain is launched upward with infinite velocity.
scenes.transition_in_text: With a sound like a thunderclap, the Captain is deleted from the room.
scenes.transition_out_text: A tiny star glints in the daytime sky as Kaelen exits the render distance.

scenes.outcome: The Guard Captain is launched into the stratosphere by a collision bug.
scenes.transition_in_text: The remaining guards flee in terror, leaving Artie alone in the gatehouse.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie dusts himself off and walks into the city, his bounty already rising.
scenes.end_condition_echo: The Guard Captain is launched into the stratosphere by a collision bug.

sections.title: The Blue Screen of Death
sections.end_condition: Artie escapes the first Sentinel by jumping into an unrendered map sector.
sections.intent: The System deploys Sentinels to investigate the physics anomaly.

scenes.outcome: The sky turns a solid blue, signaling a system-level intervention.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie is halfway through buying a meat skewer when the world stops.
scenes.transition_out_text: A massive, featureless stone figure drops from the blue sky.

scenes.outcome: The Sentinel identifies Artie as a 'Major Exception'.
scenes.transition_in_text: The Sentinel's head swivels 180 degrees, its eyes glowing with a red 'X'.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie drops his skewer and starts running through the frozen crowd.

scenes.outcome: Artie leads the Sentinel toward the edge of the rendered city.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie weaves through the alleys, the Sentinel's heavy steps crushing the stone behind him.
scenes.transition_out_text: He reaches the wall and sees the 'End of Render' sign.

scenes.outcome: Artie escapes the first Sentinel by jumping into an unrendered map sector.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie takes a leap of faith into the grey mist, leaving the physics engine behind.
scenes.transition_out_text: The Sentinel stops at the edge, unable to process the lack of terrain.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie escapes the first Sentinel by jumping into an unrendered map sector.

sections.title: The Asset Graveyard
sections.end_condition: Artie finds a fragment of 'Legacy Code' hidden in a deleted asset.
sections.intent: Artie navigates the 'Dead-Zone' where the game's UI and tracking fail.

scenes.outcome: Artie discovers a collection of discarded models and textures.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie walks through the void until he bumps into a giant, untextured duck.
scenes.transition_out_text: He realizes this is where the developers dump their mistakes.

scenes.outcome: Artie finds a chest that is labeled 'DO_NOT_USE_V1'.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie digs through a pile of low-poly trees and finds a chest with a red warning label.
scenes.transition_out_text: He tries to open it, but the chest demands a developer key.

scenes.outcome: Artie uses his glitched Luck to 'guess' the developer password.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie types 'password123' into the floating prompt, and it actually works.
scenes.transition_out_text: The chest lid flies open, revealing a pulsating orb of raw code.

scenes.outcome: Artie finds a fragment of 'Legacy Code' hidden in a deleted asset.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie reaches into the chest and grabs the orb, which feels like cold electricity.
scenes.transition_out_text: The fragment merges with his UI, adding a new 'Legacy' tab.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie finds a fragment of 'Legacy Code' hidden in a deleted asset.

sections.title: Stealth Mode
sections.end_condition: Artie successfully masks his signature from the System's tracking UI.
sections.intent: Artie integrates the code to hide from the System's active scanning.

scenes.outcome: Artie begins the process of injecting the Legacy Code into his character profile.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie opens the Legacy tab and starts dragging lines of code over his 'Entity Signature'.
scenes.transition_out_text: The UI flickers as it tries to reconcile the old code with the new system.

scenes.outcome: The Sentinel's tracking beam passes right through Artie without alerting.
scenes.transition_in_text: The Sentinel's red beam sweeps over the graveyard, but Artie's icon doesn't appear on its radar.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie holds his breath, watching the beam move on to a pile of broken pillars.

scenes.outcome: Artie successfully masks his signature from the System's tracking UI.
scenes.transition_in_text: The injection is complete; Artie is now invisible to the system's automated patrols.
scenes.transition_out_text: He heads back toward the city, ready to find more exploits.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie successfully masks his signature from the System's tracking UI.

sections.title: Backdoor Entry
sections.end_condition: Artie clips through the dungeon's terrain to bypass the level-gate.
sections.intent: Artie locates a high-level dungeon and finds a way to bypass its requirements.

scenes.outcome: Artie finds the entrance to the 'Forbidden Crypts', a level 60 dungeon.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie sneaks past the level 60 wolves, his new stealth mask working perfectly.
scenes.transition_out_text: The doors are locked behind a Level 60 requirement, but Artie isn't looking at the doors.

scenes.outcome: Artie identifies a corner where the rock texture doesn't meet the door frame.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie runs his hand along the rock wall until his fingers disappear into the stone.
scenes.transition_out_text: He realizes he can just walk through the gap if he hits it at the right angle.

scenes.outcome: Artie clips through the dungeon's terrain to bypass the level-gate.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie sprints at the corner and glitches through, popping out on the other side of the gate.
scenes.transition_out_text: He is inside the level 60 dungeon, and the first skeleton is already turning toward him.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie clips through the dungeon's terrain to bypass the level-gate.

sections.title: Pathfinding Errors
sections.end_condition: Artie traps the corrupted guardian in an infinite pathfinding loop.
sections.intent: Artie tackles the dungeon boss by exploiting its AI limitations.

scenes.outcome: Artie reaches the Boss Room of the Forbidden Crypts.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie runs through the corridors, pulling every mob in the dungeon behind him.
scenes.transition_out_text: He slams the boss room doors shut, locking the mobs outside.

scenes.outcome: The 'Corrupted Guardian' boss awakens and begins its attack pattern.
scenes.transition_in_text: The stone guardian on the throne cracks open, revealing a core of purple energy.
scenes.transition_out_text: The guardian lunges, but Artie is already looking for a pathing exploit.

scenes.outcome: Artie positions himself on a small ledge that the boss's AI cannot navigate to.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie jumps onto a decorative pillar and then to a ledge that is technically 'out of bounds'.
scenes.transition_out_text: The guardian stops mid-charge, its head twitching as it tries to calculate a path.

scenes.outcome: Artie traps the corrupted guardian in an infinite pathfinding loop.
scenes.transition_in_text: The boss begins to run in circles at the base of the ledge, unable to jump or path around.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie pulls out a basic tutorial bow and starts the long process of whittling down the boss.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie traps the corrupted guardian in an infinite pathfinding loop.

sections.title: The Null Pointer
sections.end_condition: Artie retrieves the 'Null-Pointer Blade' from the corrupted chest.
sections.intent: Artie reaches the final loot chest and claims his prize.

scenes.outcome: The Corrupted Guardian dies, dropping a unique loot key.
scenes.transition_in_text: The final arrow hits the guardian's core, and it shatters into a thousand purple shards.
scenes.transition_out_text: A massive chest rises from the floor behind the throne.

scenes.outcome: Artie opens the chest to find an item that is actively deleting its own description.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie inserts the key, and the chest lid slowly creaks open.
scenes.transition_out_text: Inside lies a blade made of flickering black pixels.

scenes.outcome: Artie retrieves the 'Null-Pointer Blade' from the corrupted chest.
scenes.transition_in_text: As his fingers close around the hilt, the world around him begins to lag.
scenes.transition_out_text: He has the ultimate weapon for a glitch-hunter, but the Administrator is watching.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie retrieves the 'Null-Pointer Blade' from the corrupted chest.

sections.title: Zone Lockdown
sections.end_condition: The Administrator locks the zone, preventing any escape or clipping.
sections.intent: The Regional Administrator forces a direct confrontation to delete Artie.

scenes.outcome: Admin Xyla appears in the dungeon, freezing all physics.
scenes.transition_in_text: The air in the boss room crystallizes as Admin Xyla teleports in.
scenes.transition_out_text: She looks at Artie with cold, digital eyes. 'Enough is enough.'

scenes.outcome: Xyla initiates a 'Zone Hard-Lock' protocol.
scenes.transition_in_text: Xyla raises her hand, and red laser grids snap into place over every exit.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie tries to run toward the terrain seam, but it's been patched in real-time.

scenes.outcome: Artie's inventory is partially disabled by the Admin's commands.
scenes.transition_in_text: Xyla snaps her fingers, and Artie's health potions and armor turn grey in his inventory.
scenes.transition_out_text: The Null-Pointer Blade, however, refuses to be disabled.

scenes.outcome: The Administrator locks the zone, preventing any escape or clipping.
scenes.transition_in_text: The lockdown is complete; the dungeon is now an isolated server instance.
scenes.transition_out_text: Xyla draws a sword made of pure light. 'Time to delete the bug.'
scenes.end_condition_echo: The Administrator locks the zone, preventing any escape or clipping.

sections.title: Logic Bomb
sections.end_condition: Artie connects the Null-Pointer Blade to the boss's core logic stream.
sections.intent: Artie uses his glitched items to fight a superior opponent.

scenes.outcome: Artie uses the Null-Pointer Blade to parry Xyla's light sword.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie swings the pixelated blade, and it meets Xyla's light sword with a shower of sparks.
scenes.transition_out_text: Every time the blades touch, Xyla's avatar glitches momentarily.

scenes.outcome: Artie realizes that the blade can 'cut' the Admin's command lines.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie sees the floating strings of code that Xyla is using to control the fight.
scenes.transition_out_text: He slashes at a line marked 'SET_PLAYER_HP_0', and the text shatters.

scenes.outcome: Xyla becomes frustrated and exposes her core logic stream to finish the fight.
scenes.transition_in_text: Xyla's composure breaks. 'You think you're clever? Let's see you handle the source code!'
scenes.transition_out_text: A massive pillar of light erupts from her chest, connecting her to the server.

scenes.outcome: Artie connects the Null-Pointer Blade to the boss's core logic stream.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie dives through a volley of light spears and stabs the Null-Pointer Blade into the blue stream.
scenes.transition_out_text: The entire dungeon begins to turn into a kaleidoscope of error messages.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie connects the Null-Pointer Blade to the boss's core logic stream.

sections.title: Fatal Exception
sections.end_condition: The boss crashes, triggering a system-wide emergency maintenance warning.
sections.intent: The boss battle concludes by breaking the game's stability.

scenes.outcome: The data stream begins to feed junk data into the server.
scenes.transition_in_text: The Null-Pointer Blade acts as a siphon, pouring Artie's glitched Luck into the server's core.
scenes.transition_out_text: Xyla screams as her avatar begins to de-rez into blocks.

scenes.outcome: The dungeon's walls begin to disappear, revealing the void beyond.
scenes.transition_in_text: The floor falls away, leaving Artie and Xyla on a single floating tile.
scenes.transition_out_text: The server's stability meter hits 0%.

scenes.outcome: Xyla's avatar crashes, and she is forcibly disconnected.
scenes.transition_in_text: With a final, distorted screech, Xyla vanishes in a puff of blue pixels.
scenes.transition_out_text: A massive red box fills Artie's vision: 'FATAL EXCEPTION'.

scenes.outcome: The boss crashes, triggering a system-wide emergency maintenance warning.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie is spat out of the dungeon as the entire zone resets.
scenes.transition_out_text: A countdown timer appears in the sky: 'Maintenance in 10:00'.
scenes.end_condition_echo: The boss crashes, triggering a system-wide emergency maintenance warning.

sections.title: The Countdown
sections.end_condition: Artie reaches the world-anchor before the maintenance timer hits zero.
sections.intent: Artie races to secure his position before the server patches him out.

scenes.outcome: Artie identifies the location of the 'World Anchor' in the capital city.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie sprints through the woods, his glitched Luck pointing him toward the city center.
scenes.transition_out_text: The timer in the sky hits 08:00.

scenes.outcome: Artie uses a glitched speed-boost by jumping repeatedly against a fence.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie finds a wooden fence and begins 'crouch-jumping', gaining massive forward momentum.
scenes.transition_out_text: He blurs past the frozen guards and reaches the cathedral doors.

scenes.outcome: Artie reaches the world-anchor before the maintenance timer hits zero.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie slides into the basement just as the timer hits 02:00.
scenes.transition_out_text: The World Anchor is right in front of him, humming with the power of reality.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie reaches the world-anchor before the maintenance timer hits zero.

sections.title: Hard-Coding Reality
sections.end_condition: Artie successfully injects a 'ignore_all_updates' flag into the local zone.
sections.intent: Artie attempts to write himself permanently into the world's architecture.

scenes.outcome: Artie uses the Null-Pointer Blade to open the World Anchor's interface.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie stabs the blade into the base of the crystal, and a developer console opens.
scenes.transition_out_text: He begins typing at a speed that would make his old boss cry.

scenes.outcome: Artie begins the injection of the 'ignore_all_updates' flag.
scenes.transition_in_text: The command line reads: 'SET_ZONE_UPDATE_POLICY = IGNORE'.
scenes.transition_out_text: The system begins to fight back, sending white 'Auto-Repair' bots into the room.

scenes.outcome: Artie defends the console from the Auto-Repair bots.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie fights with one hand and types with the other, his Luck causing the bots to collide with each other.
scenes.transition_out_text: The timer hits 00:30. The injection is at 90%.

scenes.outcome: Artie successfully injects a 'ignore_all_updates' flag into the local zone.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie hits the 'Enter' key just as the timer hits zero.
scenes.transition_out_text: Everything goes white as the server shuts down for maintenance.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie successfully injects a 'ignore_all_updates' flag into the local zone.

sections.title: Patch Day
sections.end_condition: Artie settles into his glitched sanctuary as the server comes back online.
sections.intent: The world updates, but Artie remains as a permanent resident.

scenes.outcome: Artie wakes up in a world that has been updated around him.
scenes.transition_in_text: The world re-renders, but Artie is still standing exactly where he was.
scenes.transition_out_text: He checks his UI; his level, his ring, and his blade are all still there.

scenes.outcome: Artie realizes that Oakhaven is now a 'Safe Zone' where system commands fail.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie walks out into the square and sees a Sentinel trying to enter, only to bounce off an invisible wall.
scenes.transition_out_text: He has created a permanent bug in the system, a sanctuary for himself.

scenes.outcome: Artie settles into his glitched sanctuary as the server comes back online.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie sits on the edge of the fountain, watching the new patch notes scroll past in the sky.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie settles into his glitched sanctuary as the server comes back online.
